description:
# Phantom Movies v1.7.4

## Library, Discover and navigation

- Rename Favorites List to Library and Explore to Discover.
- Redesign Library with a prominent search field, All/Movies/TV shows filtering, horizontal sorting controls, and a responsive poster grid with watched marks and playback progress.
- Open the full Discover catalog from Library search to find movies and TV shows, and make the Discover genre-and-sort filter sheet available for organizing saved titles.
- Add Last Watched, Name, Name Descending and Recently Added sorting, with cached metadata for advanced filters.
- Restore the original detail-page back arrow and keep it accessible above scrolling content.
- Fix corrupted characters in the View More description label and improve spacing between settings sections.

## Playback controls and subtitles

- Match language, selection and color sheets to interface, with rounded controls, clearer selection indicators and Phantom red accents.
- Rework audio and quality selectors, with scrollable sheets for smaller screens and landscape playback.
- Bundle language flag images with the app so they do not depend on an external image server or device emoji support.
- Bring embedded and add-on subtitles into one panel, grouped and filterable by language, with the selected track clearly marked.
- Turn subtitles off or switch between embedded and add-on tracks from the same panel.
- Adjust subtitle text size, vertical position and colors during playback, and adjust timing for the current source up to 10 seconds earlier or later.
- Show available add-on subtitles while other providers are still loading.
- Simplify the Skip Intro setting and use TheIntroDB as the primary marker provider, with the previous IntroDB service as a backup.

## Sources and add-ons

- Show clearer provider labels, a selected-source indicator and available source counts while remaining add-ons load.
- Add a retry option when source add-ons cannot be reached.
- Keep add-on sources ahead of Phantom sources, preserving add-on installation order across account sync and configuration updates.
- Share add-on ordering with the dashboard and TV v1.4.0.

## Trakt, SIMKL and recommendations

- Add Trakt watchlists and favorites, plus SIMKL Plan to Watch and Watching lists, to Phantom's connected-account features.
- Use the existing Favorites/Library action to choose Phantom Favorites, Trakt lists or supported SIMKL statuses from one themed menu.
- Add connected-account recommendations alongside the original Home sections, with controls to hide or reorder connected-account sections.
- Merge supported connected-account playback progress into the main Continue Watching section.
- Import watched movies and episodes, including episodes from completed SIMKL shows, and fix Trakt episode-history imports for its current API.
- Refresh immediately on manual sync and upload completed local history that has not already synced, preserving its recorded dates.
- Preserve watched marks through partial updates, reconcile removed items and retry interrupted syncs without saving incomplete results.
- Keep watchlists and favorites separate from watched history and unfinished playback.
- Preserve local Phantom saves when disconnecting a provider, keep provider data separate for each Phantom account and retain cached lists during provider outages.
- Support paginated Trakt lists and distinguish unavailable lists, unavailable progress, unmatched titles and pending updates from successful or empty results.

## Continue Watching and series cards

- Show new-episode counts on eligible TV-series cards across Home and add-on sections, using local or connected-account watch history.
- Count aired, unwatched episodes after the latest watched episode and exclude episodes that have not aired.
- Replace section-card ratings with watched checkmarks at the upper left and new-episode counts at the upper right; keep ratings on title details.
- Replace the Continue Watching corner season/episode pill with the watched checkmark. Season and episode information remains on the play action.
- Preserve episode information and progress on watch-history cards without adding an extra episode-count overlay.
- Mark upcoming episodes in details with an amber **Not released yet** label.
- Match Trakt and SIMKL recommendation cards to the default poster sizes and rounded corners.
- Cache episode metadata, fix missing artwork on imported Continue Watching cards and load artwork for visible cards instead of an entire imported library at once.

## Sharing

- Add a share sheet with an app icon grid and a copy option.
- Share the movie or series title, year when available, matching TMDB title link and Phantom Movies website, instead of using a title's external homepage.

## Profile and personalization

- Add account header, Edit Profile screen and avatar selection bottom sheet.
- Include fourteen free character avatars plus the account-photo option, with additional Supporter and Supporter Plus portraits and in-app supporter badges.
- Add optional accent themes, gradients and account backgrounds shared with the TV app and dashboard.
- Show actual color and background previews, save appearance selections to the Phantom account and clearly label membership-locked previews.
- Support personalization with Google sign-in and existing Phantom accounts.

## Account sync and dashboard

- Sync phone quality, language, region and light/dark preferences with the account dashboard while connected.
- Keep pending preference edits separate for each account and retry offline changes after reconnection.
- Register signed-in phones in the dashboard's device list and support individual remote sign-out when the app connects.
- Continue sharing profile appearance, library, add-ons and watch progress across supported Phantom clients.

## Ad-free experience and service improvements

- Remove remaining advertising SDKs, banner placements and playback ad delays. Core app features remain free.
- Route catalog, Trakt, SIMKL and intro-marker requests through the Phantom API.
- Add shared catalog caching and a backup TMDB key for confirmed invalid-key failures.

## Smaller downloads

- Add smaller ARM64 and ARM32 phone downloads, with a universal APK for broader compatibility and a separate x86-64 download.
- Compress native playback libraries and remove unused dependency code and resources to reduce download size.
- Select compatible APKs during in-app updates and show architecture choices on the website.

## Availability

- Remote device sign-out requires the phone to connect. The website must be running or deployed for dashboard features to be accessible.
- Supporter cosmetics require an active membership. Live Stripe checkout.

releases.description:
# Phantom Movies v1.7.3

## Subtitle fixes

- Fixed subtitle addon lookup for built-in Phantom titles that need their movie or episode identifier resolved.
- Fixed addon subtitles that appeared in the menu but did not display during playback.
- Improved SRT, WebVTT, and SSA/ASS support, including download links without file extensions, compressed responses, redirects, and UTF-16 subtitle files.
- Fixed manual addon subtitle selection when the preferred subtitle setting is Off.
- Kept playback position and pause state when switching or removing addon subtitles.
- Made addon results appear as providers respond, so a slow provider does not hold up the other results.
- Prevented failed or unsupported subtitle downloads from replacing the playing video.

These fixes apply to playback in the phone player for Phantom and addon streams.

# Phantom Movies v1.7.3

## Subtitle fixes

- Fixed subtitle addon lookup for built-in Phantom titles that need their movie or episode identifier resolved.
- Fixed addon subtitles that appeared in the menu but did not display during playback.
- Improved SRT, WebVTT, and SSA/ASS support, including download links without file extensions, compressed responses, redirects, and UTF-16 subtitle files.
- Fixed manual addon subtitle selection when the preferred subtitle setting is Off.
- Kept playback position and pause state when switching or removing addon subtitles.
- Made addon results appear as providers respond, so a slow provider does not hold up the other results.
- Prevented failed or unsupported subtitle downloads from replacing the playing video.

These fixes apply to playback in the phone player for Phantom and addon streams.
